name: Columbia Gas Transmission Line N West Side Expansion and Modernization Project
monitor_reason: length: replaces 23 mi of 20-inch with 24-inch (old pipe made inactive), so no sourced new pipe of 25 km or more; sponsor is National Fuel Gas Supply, not Columbia
researcher_notes: Replacement project, completed 2015. The Federal Register notice of March 3, 2014 for docket CP14-70 says National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation (not Columbia Gas Transmission) asked to replace about 23 miles of 20-inch pipeline in western Pennsylvania with 24-inch pipeline, make the replaced pipe inactive, and add one 3,550-horsepower compressor unit at the Mercer Compressor Station. The EIA August 2026 release (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 799) lists it as an Expansion by NiSource Gas Transmission and Storage, 23 mi, 24 in, 175 MMcf/d added, in service September 2015. EIA appears to name the wrong company. The line is a swap of existing pipe, so it does not add 25 km of new pipe. No existing GEM row matches under another name; National Fuel rows are P6878 (Main Line), P2537, P7827. Not staged as a new row. If a person wants it tracked anyway, it would sit under National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation Gas Pipeline, with the capacity addition of 175 MMcf/d from EIA. Confidence medium.
